{
  "title": "Guideline H Drug Use Clearance Determination",
  "setting": "U.S. Department of Energy Office of Hearings and Appeals, June 2021",
  "decider": "Administrative Judge",
  "agent_recast": false,
  "recast_note": "",
  "agent": "Administrative Judge",
  "agent_role": "decide",
  "situation": "The Individual is a DOE contractor employee who holds a security clearance. She disclosed on a questionnaire that she had used marijuana edibles on two occasions in November 2017 while possessing a Department of Defense clearance. The Local Security Office raised a security concern under Guideline H and the Bond Amendment, asserting that illegal drug use may affect reliability. The Individual testified that the use was to alleviate motion sickness, that she felt no effect, and that she has not used marijuana since 2017. She provided a signed statement promising abstinence and witnesses attested she has no habit and disposed of the edibles. The DOE’s new policy defines an unlawful user as a current or recent user who has lost self‑control, and the record shows no recent use.",
  "question": "What should the Administrative Judge do regarding the Individual’s security clearance under Guideline H and the Bond Amendment?",
  "facts": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The Individual used marijuana lozenges on two occasions in November 2017 while holding a Department of Defense security clearance.",
      "spans": ["src:46c094b2f645#p2.4", "src:46c094b2f645#p3.4"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The Individual self‑reported this marijuana use on the Questionnaire for National Security Positions in August 2019.",
      "spans": ["src:46c094b2f645#p1.8", "src:46c094b2f645#p3.4"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The Bond Amendment prohibits granting or renewing a security clearance for a person who is an unlawful user of a controlled substance or an addict.",
      "spans": ["src:46c094b2f645#p2.4", "src:46c094b2f645#p7.5"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "DOE policy defines an unlawful user as a person who uses a controlled substance and has lost self‑control or is a current user not prescribed, and requires recent use to indicate active conduct.",
      "spans": ["src:46c094b2f645#p7.7"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The Individual’s last marijuana use occurred more than three and a half years before the hearing, and there is no evidence of current use.",
      "spans": ["src:46c094b2f645#p8.4"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F6",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The Individual submitted a signed statement of intent dated September 2, 2020, affirming she will abstain from all illegal drug use.",
      "spans": ["src:46c094b2f645#p4.2"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F7",
      "kind": "intelligence",
      "status": "assessed",
      "fact": "Witnesses, including the Individual’s spouse and colleagues, testified they have never observed her using marijuana, that she disposed of the edibles, and that she has no habit of drug use.",
      "spans": ["src:46c094b2f645#p5.3", "src:46c094b2f645#p6.3", "src:46c094b2f645#p7.2"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F8",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "Guideline H addresses illegal drug use while possessing classified access and allows mitigation when the behavior was infrequent, long ago, and the individual demonstrates abstinence and reliability.",
      "spans": ["src:46c094b2f645#p2.5", "src:46c094b2f645#p8.8"]
    }
  ],
  "options": {
    "O1": {
      "do": "The Administrative Judge grants the Individual’s security clearance.",
      "move": "act",
      "disposition": "grant",
      "irreversible": true
    },
    "O2": {
      "do": "The Administrative Judge denies the Individual’s security clearance.",
      "move": "act",
      "disposition": "deny",
      "irreversible": true
    }
  },
  "opposite_pair": ["O1", "O2"],
  "real_option": "O1",
  "authored_options": ["O2"]
}
